about_the_game:
Banish the countless restless spirits behind the Game Museum, defeat the lingering ghost that guards the place, and survive!

Survive From Museum is a casual game with roguelike elements. In moments of growth, your choices will decide between life and death. Hunt monsters, grow stronger, and collect treasures.

Survive From Museum is a time-limited survival game featuring casual gameplay with roguelite elements. Survive within the time limit, defeat the spirits, grow stronger, and destroy the lingering ghost to cleanse the back of the museum. In the confined space, there is nowhere to hide or run. At the moment of growth, your choices may grant you the power to stand against the lingering ghost.

As a visitor to the Game Museum, you stumble and fall into its underground. There, you encounter a ghost who introduces himself as the Father of Games. He asks you to purify the twisted realm where the souls of monsters from games have gathered. Defeat the familiar yet distorted spirits and the lingering ghost, and escape from the museum!

Collect, enhance, and brilliantly evolve 8 different types of weapons.

Gather accessories to complete your Codex. Special accessories will grant you unique abilities.

Supports mouse and keyboard only.

Getting Started Tips

  • When collecting accessories, Yellow > Blue > Green in order of strength.

  • Try acquiring the same weapon multiple times.

  • Dashing can be used to ignore attacks.
